checks: concurrent FEFO issues: one accepted, no overselling.
concurrent same-period opname creation: one draft, one friendly rejection.
concurrent shared daily drafts: one save accepted, stale write rejected, creator and actor preserved.
concurrent daily approval and MySQL JSON snapshot round-trip.
unit edit versus first receipt: serialized, no historical relabeling.
concurrent first receipts: one balance row, both additions retained.
concurrent multi-item transfers: second-item failure rolls back the entire losing transfer.
concurrent multi-item duplicate reference: one complete transfer posted once.

limitations: Working tree verification, not a clean published commit
Synthetic automated checks, not manual clinic UAT
VDI/public domain not deployed or tested for writes
No production data, passwords, keys, or session cookies included
